This directory holds the small smoke corpus used by the test suite.

- `sample.pdf` covers the PDF path and exercises paragraph extraction plus table synthesis.
- `contract.docx` covers the DOCX path and exercises the same bundle contract.
- `scan.png` covers the image path and keeps the image branch in the harness.

The goal is not to store huge fixtures here. The test data is intentionally small so the repo stays quick to clone and easy to understand.
